traceability.notes:
The story docs/stories/005.0-DEV-ANNOTATION-VALIDATION.story.md is fully implemented.
All acceptance criteria are met: - Core Functionality: The traceability/valid-annotation-format rule validates @story and @req annotation syntax and format, backed by comprehensive tests that cover valid and invalid cases, including edge conditions like missing values, bad extensions, traversal, and malformed IDs. - Quality Standards: The rule follows ESLint best practices: it exposes meta, messages, and a JSON schema; uses RuleTester for tests; and handles configuration via a dedicated options helper with defensive regex validation and clear configuration errors. - Integration: The rule scans all comments at the Program level and works independently of where annotations are introduced, so it integrates with annotations used by function and branch rules without tight coupling. - User Experience: Error messages are specific and actionable, distinguishing missing vs invalid values, echoing the offending path/ID, and providing concrete examples. Tests assert exact message text. - Error Handling: The implementation safely handles malformed comments, empty lines, multiline annotations, and invalid regex options, always falling back to defaults where needed instead of failing. - Documentation: docs/rules/valid-annotation-format.md documents the format rules, default patterns, configuration, and examples of valid and invalid annotations, matching the story’s examples.
Each explicit requirement in the story (REQ-FORMAT-SPECIFICATION, REQ-SYNTAX-VALIDATION, REQ-PATH-FORMAT, REQ-REQ-FORMAT, REQ-MULTILINE-SUPPORT, REQ-FLEXIBLE-PARSING, REQ-ERROR-SPECIFICITY) has corresponding implementation and passing tests. Therefore the assessment for this story is PASSED.
